errors.text_span: erreicht um 1995 einen Wert von etwa 1,6 Prozent
errors.evidence: The value on the green line at the 1995 mark is approximately 1.8%, not 1.6%.

errors.text_span: Von 1995 bis 2015 bleibt die Linie im Bereich zwischen 1,3 und 1,6 Prozent, mit leichten Schwankungen.
errors.evidence: This statement is incorrect. During the period from 1995 to 2015, the line shows a clear downward trend, starting at approximately 1.8% in 1995 and decreasing to a minimum of about 1.3% around 2015. It does not remain within the 1.3% to 1.6% range for the entire period.

errors.text_span: erreicht im Jahr 2020 einen Wert von etwa 1,7 Prozent
errors.evidence: The value on the green line at the year 2020 mark is approximately 1.5%, not 1.7%. The line reaches approximately 1.7% at its final data point, which is visibly after the year 2020.
